aggregation: EPSG:5070 true cell/polygon intersection; categorical area / full cell; intensive finite-area weighted mean
geometry_repair_policy: For invalid source geometry, apply shapely.make_valid in EPSG:5070; accept only non-empty Polygon/MultiPolygon with finite positive original and repaired projected areas and relative area change <=1e-6; otherwise mask affected WUI values.
row_order: ascending cell_id within ascending tile order
target_mask_rule: BP>0 and all FLPs GDAL-valid, finite, in [0,1], and abs(float64 sum-1)<=1e-6
topology_policy: Positive overlap, duplicate source coverage, coverage excess, and categorical-share error <=1e-6 of cell area are tolerated and reported; material discrepancies mask affected WUI values; no renormalization.
